records.source: The folder that holds the saved answers, one file per question. Empty uses answers in results/ops_voyager3. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: 存放已保存回答的文件夹，每个问题一个文件。留空时使用 results/ops_voyager3 中的 answers。默认值 None。Alpha。

records.source: The column of the cluster table that holds each gene's cluster, such as cluster or leiden_r10. Default 'cluster'. Alpha.
records.translation: 聚类表中存放每个基因所属聚类的列，例如 cluster 或 leiden_r10。默认值 'cluster'。Alpha。

records.source: Annotate only these clusters, such as 3,17,40. Empty annotates every cluster with at least two genes. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: 只注释这些聚类，例如 3,17,40。留空时注释每个至少含两个基因的聚类。默认值 None。Alpha。

records.source: The cluster table Voyager3 annotates: a gene column and the column ops_voyager3_cluster_column names. Empty reads results/ops_clusters/consensus_partition.csv of this run. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: Voyager3 注释的聚类表：一个基因列和 ops_voyager3_cluster_column 指定的列。留空时读取本次运行的 results/ops_clusters/consensus_partition.csv。默认值 None。Alpha。

records.source: A sentence on the screen that every prompt includes: cell type, stains or markers, and the cell population, such as 'HeLa cells, interphase, DNA and tubulin stains'. Empty says not given. Default ''. Alpha.
records.translation: 每条提示词都包含的一句关于筛选的描述：细胞类型、染色或标志物，以及细胞群体，例如 'HeLa cells, interphase, DNA and tubulin stains'。留空时注明未提供。默认值 ''。Alpha。

records.source: Run Voyager3 after the clustering phases: every cluster's genes get their reviewed UniProt facts (function, GO, pathway, location, annotation score), and the AI chosen under Preferences names the role the cluster shares, how confident it is, the genes that support it, those that do not fit and the poorly characterised genes worth following up. The phase voyager3 runs it on its own. Writes results/ops_voyager3. Default False. Alpha.
records.translation: 在聚类阶段之后运行 Voyager3：为每个聚类的基因获取经审阅的 UniProt 事实（功能、GO、通路、定位、注释评分），并由在首选项中选择的 AI 指出该聚类共有的功能、其置信程度、支持该功能的基因、不符合的基因，以及值得跟进的表征不足的基因。voyager3 阶段可单独运行它。写入 results/ops_voyager3。默认值 False。Alpha。

records.source: The model name passed to that AI. Empty uses its default. The name is saved with the results. Default ''. Alpha.
records.translation: 传给该 AI 的模型名称。留空时使用其默认模型。该名称随结果一起保存。默认值 ''。Alpha。

records.source: The organism whose UniProt entries Voyager3 reads, as a name (human, mouse) or a taxon id. Default 'human'. Alpha.
records.translation: Voyager3 读取其 UniProt 条目的物种，以名称（human、mouse）或分类单元 id 表示。默认值 'human'。Alpha。

records.source: The AI that answers: spacr_hosted (spaCR AI, free), or claude, codex or gemini, each the command-line tool signed in with your own account. Empty uses the choice under Preferences > AI. The report names the provider and model, and says when the free provider answered with its smaller model. Default ''. Alpha.
records.translation: 作答的 AI：spacr_hosted（spaCR AI，免费），或 claude、codex 或 gemini，后三者各自为用您自己的账户登录的命令行工具。留空时使用 首选项 > AI 中的选择。报告会注明提供方和模型，并在免费提供方使用其较小模型作答时加以说明。默认值 ''。Alpha。

records.source: Save each answer as it arrives and, on a rerun, reuse the saved answer of every question asked before, so an interrupted run goes on where it stopped and gives the same tables. Only questions with the same prompt, model and template version are reused; failed or timed-out calls are asked again. Off asks every cluster again. Default True. Alpha.
records.translation: 每个回答一到达即保存，重新运行时复用此前问过的每个问题的已保存回答，因此中断的运行会从停止处继续，并得到相同的表格。只复用提示词、模型和模板版本都相同的问题；失败或超时的调用会重新询问。关闭时对每个聚类重新询问。默认值 True。Alpha。

records.source: Also annotate a control: the same cluster sizes with the genes shuffled across clusters (fixed seed), so a coherent role in a real cluster can be compared with how often one turns up by chance. Doubles the number of questions. Default False. Alpha.
records.translation: 同时注释一个对照：聚类大小相同，但基因在聚类间打乱（固定种子），以便将真实聚类中的一致功能与偶然出现此类功能的频率进行比较。提问次数加倍。默认值 False。Alpha。

records.source: Seconds one cluster's answer may take before it is stopped and asked once more. Default 300. Alpha.
records.translation: 单个聚类的回答允许耗费的秒数，超时后停止并再询问一次。默认值 300。Alpha。

records.source: Annotate clusters (Voyager3)
records.translation: 注释聚类（Voyager3）

records.key: Fetch every cluster gene's UniProt facts and ask the AI chosen under Preferences to name each cluster's biological role. Runs only this step, on the cluster table in the settings above, and writes results/ops_voyager3.
records.source: Fetch every cluster gene's UniProt facts and ask the AI chosen under Preferences to name each cluster's biological role. Runs only this step, on the cluster table in the settings above, and writes results/ops_voyager3.
records.translation: 获取每个聚类基因的 UniProt 事实，并请在首选项中选择的 AI 指出每个聚类的生物学功能。只运行这一步，使用上方设置中的聚类表，并写入 results/ops_voyager3。

records.translation: 尚未运行。
